guidance.summary: Full year revenue growth of 20% plus
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: Company is hopeful to achieve 20% plus growth in full year period and also will improve our operating margin in FY '25-'26.

guidance.summary: CAGR revenue growth of more than 20% in next 3 to 4 years
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: After completing the Sanand project and the strong demand in domestic and overseas markets, we are hopeful to grow more than 20% in next CAGR in next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.summary: Incremental top line of INR 6,000 crores by March 2029
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: By FY '29, we should achieve this entire INR6,000 crores incremental top line. Is that fair understanding? Anil Gupta: Yes, yes.

guidance.summary: Q4 revenue growth anywhere around 25% plus
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: No, I think the growth in this quarter should be anywhere between around 25% plus.

guidance.summary: Next year EBITDA margin of around 11%
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: I think we have already given a guidance that next year, we expect to achieve EBITDA margins of around 11% overall for the full year.

guidance.summary: Sanand turnover close to INR 2,700 crores next year
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: So next year also from the Sanand itself, we will have the turnover close to INR2,700 crores from the Sanand itself.

guidance.qualifier: CAGR for the next 4 to 5 years
guidance.summary: Targeting close to 20% CAGR growth for the next 4 to 5 years
guidance.quote: We are targeting close to 20% CAGR growth for the next 4 to 5 years.
